zh: 这里有至关重要的情报需要获取

#en: A ruthless Crimson Fleet raiding party is assaulting <Alias=DungeonLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanet>, threatening both key facilities and civilians. Deploy immediately to repel the pirates, protect vital systems, and restore order.
zh: 一支凶残的深红舰队劫掠队正在袭击<Alias=TargetPlanet>上的<Alias=DungeonLocation>，关键设施与平民均受到威胁。立即出击，击退海盗，保护重要系统并恢复秩序。

#en: Out on this nowhere rock, customs scans go blind and manifests are written in favors instead of ink, which makes it the perfect place to bury proof that certain wrecks were never accidents. The crews that move through here know which questions not to ask and how to keep their opinions trimmed down to survivable size; the ones who forgot that have already drifted into rumor. So far, all I have are a stray slate from an old job, a handful of nervous stories from freight hands, and timing gaps in official logs that keep lining up with the same missing ships.
zh: 在这块鸟不拉屎的破石头上，海关扫描形同虚设，舱单不是用墨水、而是用人情写就，这让它成了掩埋"某些残骸绝非意外"之证据的绝佳地点。途经此地的船员都懂得哪些问题不该问，也懂得怎样把话收进能保命的尺寸；忘了这一点的那些人，早已化作流言。眼下我手上只有一块旧差事留下的散落数据板、货运工口中几桩紧张兮兮的故事，以及官方日志里那些总与同一批失踪船只对得上的时间空档。

#en: The wreckage drifts in a slow, unnatural tumble, not quite following the orbital math every spacer here swears by but none of them care to question out loud. Whatever is embedded in that twisted metal has already convinced the locals to speak carefully about misjumps and "lucky" course changes, as if the wrong word might pull their own vectors off-center. Shattering it here, where the pattern first bled into real space, is the only way to see whether the anomaly was accident or design. So far all I have is a lonely outpost log and hushed stories that stop just short of naming him.
zh: 残骸以缓慢而不自然的姿态翻滚漂移，并不完全遵循此地每个太空劫匪都信誓旦旦、却又没人愿意出声质疑的轨道数学。嵌在那扭曲金属里的东西，已经让当地人谈及跃迁失误和"幸运的"航向变更时格外谨慎，仿佛说错一个词就会把自身的向量拽偏。在这里、在这个模式最初渗入真实空间的地方把它击碎，是判断这异常究竟出于意外还是设计的唯一办法。眼下我只有一份孤零零的前哨日志，以及那些在即将说出他名字前戛然而止的低语。

#en: If his work has a spine, it runs through this tower. Ryujin keeps its projections and off-ledger models here, the same streams he has been quietly bending to justify which colonies are starved and which are fed. Somewhere in the routines and timestamps is the cadence of his hand, a rhythm of interventions that will point to where he intends to cut next. The pattern has been circling tighter since that stray dataslate on a backworld, the doctored orbital beacon, and the first hints of corporate fingerprints on a dead ice colony. All of it keeps resolving to the same quiet signature.
zh: 如果说他的行当有一根脊柱，那它一定穿过这座塔。龙神集团把它的预测模型和账外模型都放在这里，正是他一直在暗中弯折的那些数据流，用来证明哪些殖民地该挨饿、哪些该被供养。在那些例行程序和时戳之间，藏着那只手的节拍，一种干预的韵律，会指出他下一步打算在哪里下刀。自从穷乡星上那块散落数据板、被做过手脚的轨道信标，以及某座死寂冰封殖民地首次浮现的公司指纹之后，这个模式就越收越紧。一切都不断归结为同一个安静的签名。

#en: If anyone has the means to hide a man who rewrites air for a living, it is the executives who own the pumps and vents above Neon's stormlit sea.  \nBuried in their climate logs and maintenance schedules is the quiet truth of whose contracts they honor and whose disasters they erase, and the gaps in those records will tell you where he is being tolerated, if not welcomed.  \nSo far the trail has been hearsay from a lonely outpost, a courier's altered manifests, and a mechanic's half-wiped configs, all insisting he moves with corporate blessing even as every official mouth denies his name.
zh: 若说谁有本事藏起一个以改写大气为生的人，那就是坐拥霓虹城风暴之海上那些泵与通风管道的董事们。  \n他们气候日志与维护日程里埋着这样一个安静的真相：他们兑现谁的合同、抹掉谁的灾祸；而那些记录里的空缺会告诉你，他在何处被容忍、乃至被欢迎。  \n目前为止，这条线索只有来自一座孤零零前哨的道听途说、一名信使被篡改的舱单，以及一名机械师被抹掉一半的配置——它们都坚称他行事有公司背书，尽管每一张官方的嘴都否认他的名字。

#en: Down here under the grid, where lightning walks the Span and the walls hum with stolen power, there is no better place to buy a way into someone else s secrets; every illicit channel, every rerouted packet, eventually brushes past the hands that haunt Neon s lowest decks. The thing you are after changes owners every week, passed in whispers from fixer to smuggler to corporate shadow, and no one ever admits they were the first to touch it. The only common story is that it started with a dead Navy ship, a blackout no one could explain, and a quiet pattern riding the static toward the frontier.
zh: 在这张电网之下、闪电行走于桥架上、四壁因偷来的电力而嗡鸣的地方，没有比这里更适合买通别人的秘密了；每条非法信道、每个被改道的封包，最终都会与那些出没于霓虹城最下层甲板的手擦身而过。你要找的东西每周都换主人，从掮客到走私者再到公司的影子，一路靠低语传递，没人承认自己碰过它。唯一流传一致的版本是：它始于一艘报废的海军飞船、一场无人能解释的断电，以及一个乘着静电朝边境漫去的安静模式。

#en: Out here, above an unnamed world, the beacon hangs where no chart says it should, pulsing in time with a grav seam only a traffic veteran would ever notice. Someone nudged a buoy here, bent a corridor there, until a private lane of shipwrecks and missing haulers quietly formed around this point. Isolating its signal in the static is the only way to see how those tiny reroutes, the delayed responses and erased queue entries, all spiraled into a pattern. So far, the trail runs from a forgotten backwater slate to doctored cargo records and a farmbound sketch that mirrors Neon's darkest power flickers.
zh: 在这里、在一颗无名世界上空，那座信标悬在没有任何星图标注的位置上，随着一道只有交通老手才会察觉的引力缝隙脉动。有人在这边轻推一座浮标，在那边掰弯一条走廊，直到一条由残骸与失踪货船构成的私人航道悄然环绕此点成形。在静电中把它的信号单独剥离出来，是看清那些细微的改道、延迟的应答与被抹除的队列条目如何盘旋成一个模式的唯一办法。目前为止，这条线索从一块被遗忘的穷乡数据板，延伸到被做过手脚的货运记录，再指向一幅与霓虹城最阴暗的电力闪烁相呼应的农场侧草图。

#en: Stories say that ship drifts just off the main lanes, never pinging the same transponder twice, like it is trying to erase its own footprints in vacuum. Whatever route data it carries is the hinge between scattered sabotage sites and the next place he plans to thin the herd, a calculated kink in the normal traffic that only a route coordinator would think to hide here. Out on that backworld, the first dataslate hinted at tampered queues; the orbital beacon logs confirmed diverted traffic; the corporate schedules in Neon traced whole colonies being starved by design. Every retelling puts him closer.
zh: 传闻说那艘船就漂在主航道外侧，从不以同一个应答器讯号出现两次，仿佛想在真空中抹掉自己的脚印。它携带的路线数据，是连接各处零散破坏点与他下一个打算"减员"之地的枢纽，一处只有航线协调员才会想到藏在这里的、计算好的交通弯折。在那颗穷乡星上，第一块数据板暗示了被篡改的队列；轨道信标日志证实了被改道的交通；霓虹城的公司日程则追溯到整片殖民地被精心设计地饿死。每一个版本的重述，都让他更近一步。

#en: The courier hangs dead in the dark, running lights cold, hull scorched just enough to look like an accident someone decided not to ask too many questions about. Whatever account of its last run survives in station bars and backroom deals has already been sanded down to something harmless; only the records sealed in its cracked systems will show which worlds it really brushed past and who signed off on the route. So far all I have are a frightened outpost talking about bad air, a vague ping tying his tools to that sector, and a sense that every retelling of the story bends away from the same unspoken name.
zh: 那艘信使船死寂地悬在黑暗中，航行灯冰冷，船壳烧灼得恰到好处，像是被定性为意外、而没人愿意多问一句的样子。关于它最后一趟航程的说法，凡是能在星际站酒吧与密室交易里留存下来的，都已被打磨成人畜无害的版本；只有当它那开裂系统里封存的记录，才能说明它究竟擦过了哪些世界，又是谁批准了这条航线。眼下我只有一座被吓坏的前哨在念叨糟糕的空气、一段把他的工具与那片星域系在一起的模糊讯号，以及一种感觉：每一个版本的故事，都在同一个未曾说出口的名字前拐弯。

#en: New Homestead is where the sky started lying, even if no one here can agree on when. Ships go and come as they always have, but the old-timers talk about a convoy that tore itself apart above the horizon and a route report that never matched what their eyes saw. Whatever twisted the numbers had to touch ground somewhere familiar, somewhere quiet enough to go unnoticed, and this settlement fits too well. So far all anyone has are secondhand rumors about a navigator who walked away from the big fleets, whispers of falsified trials at distant staryards, and one survivor who insists the lane itself was wrong.
zh: 新家园就是天空开始说谎的地方，尽管这里没人能就"从何时起"达成一致。船只照旧来往，但老人们会说起一支在地平线上方自我撕裂的车队，以及一份永远对不上他们亲眼所见的路况报告。无论是什么扭曲了那些数字，它总得在某处熟悉、又安静得足以不被注意的地方落地，而这座定居点契合得过了头。眼下所有人手里都只有二手传言：一个从大舰队出走的老领航员、远方船坞里被伪造的试航记录，以及一名幸存者，坚称那条航线本身就是错的。

#en: Out here the orbit is quiet except for the soft hiss of charged dust on the hull and the distant murmur of traffic bending around this world. The derelict you are closing on should not matter, yet its course and transponder history sit at the center of Vector's tangled corrections, a forgotten waystation where he reworked the math in a hurry and left the scars in the flight records. This is where separate threads intersect: emergency edits in jump logs, phantom waypoints injected into homesteader approaches, and a nervous dockmaster on Gagarin who swore those deviations were nothing more than pilot error.
zh: 在这里，轨道上一片寂静，只有带电尘埃拂过船壳的轻微嘶声，以及远处绕行这颗世界的交通低鸣。你正在靠近的那艘弃船本不该有什么要紧，可它的航向与应答器历史，恰恰位于"向量"那些缠成一团的修正的正中央，一座被遗忘的中转站：他在此匆忙重算了那套数学，并把伤痕留在了飞行记录里。几条不同的线索在此交汇：跃迁日志里的紧急改动、注入农场主进近航线的幽灵航点，以及加加林星上一名紧张兮兮的船坞主管，他发誓那些偏差不过是飞行员失误。

#en: The node drifts just off the standard traffic spine, balanced on a grav seam so slight most captains would write its pull off as turbulence. Its alignment with past distress bursts, missing haulers, and delayed response windows is too precise to pass as chance; every "random" detour you have mapped folds back through this point like threads through a single needle. Earlier, a forgotten slate on a nameless rock, nervous testimony from a freight depot, and the farmbound sketches of a settler who watched the skies too closely all hinted at the pattern, but here, in open orbit, the math finally starts to agree.
zh: 那个节点就漂在标准交通主轴外侧，悬在一道细微到多数船长都会把其引力当作湍流的引力缝隙上。它与过往的遇险脉冲、失踪货船、以及延迟的响应窗口之间的吻合太过精确，无法当作巧合；你标出的每一条"随机"绕行，都像穿过同一根针的线一样折回这一点。早先，无名岩石上那块被遗忘的数据板、货运站里紧张的证词，以及一名把天空看得太紧的定居者所绘的农场侧草图，都曾暗示过这个模式，但在这里、在开阔轨道上，数学终于开始对上了。

#en: Out here the beacon hangs alone in the dark, pulsing against the planet's shadow like a heartbeat that never quite syncs with official traffic. Whatever is riding its signal is bleeding through multiple registries at once, tugging ship IDs and account trails toward a single unseen point, and if it keeps drifting unchecked, whole sectors of data will quietly realign around a lie. The pattern from the ground and Neon to that dead SysDef hull all says the same thing now: foreclosures reversed with no author, warrants softened at the edges, and a single careful hand walking the line between mercy and manipulation.
zh: 在这里，那座信标孤悬于黑暗中，贴着行星的阴影脉动，像一颗始终无法与官方交通同步的心跳。附在它信号上的东西正同时渗透多个登记册，把船只 ID 与账户痕迹拽向一个看不见的点；若任其继续漂移，整片整片的数据区都会悄然围绕一个谎言重新排列。从地面、到霓虹城、再到那艘死去的星防队船体，这个模式如今都指向同一件事：没有署名人的止赎被撤销、令状的棱角被磨软，以及一只谨慎的手行走在怜悯与操弄之间。

#en: Down here under the city's polished stone, the air hums with old fans and stale coffee, and the consoles still remember things their operators were told to forget. This is where his numbers first passed from theory into routed ships and approved colonies, and where someone started tracing them backward before the trail abruptly stops. Whoever began that work either got scared, bought, or buried. Picking up their thread in this maze of half-archived queues and access logs is the only way to see how the frozen outpost, the altered beacon in orbit, and that poisoned backworld all line up along the same unseen hand.
zh: 在这座城市光洁石头之下的此处，空气因老旧风扇与放凉的咖啡而嗡鸣，控制台仍记得操作员被要求忘掉的事情。他的数字正是在这里第一次从理论变成被改道的船只与被批准的殖民地，也是在这里，有人开始逆向追查它们，而后线索骤然中断。开始那项工作的人，不是被吓住、被收买，就是被埋进了土里。在这座半归档队列与访问日志构成的迷宫里拾起他们的线头，是看清那座冰封前哨、轨道上被改动的信标，以及那颗被毒害的穷乡星如何沿着同一只无形的手排列的唯一办法。

#en: Trade Authority does not leave a hull like the Tidewalker drifting without a reason, and no honest reason explains why its cargo records were quietly excised from every open channel. Whatever is still humming in that hold is the first clean look at how routes, risk ratings, and desperate settlers got braided into one silent business model, somewhere between fear of liability and the convenience of looking away. So far, I have a dead rock full of poisoned hope, a nameless buoy whispering redlined harvests, and a scattering of altered reports that all suggest the same surveyor has been selling danger as opportunity.
zh: 贸易管理局不会无缘无故地把"潮行者"这样一艘船体扔在轨道上漂着，而没有任何光明正大的理由能解释：为何它的货运记录会被人从每一个公开信道里悄悄剔除。那间货舱里仍在嗡鸣的东西，是第一次干干净净地看清航线、风险评级与走投无路的定居者如何被编成同一种无声商业模式——就在对责任的恐惧与睁一只眼闭一只眼的便利之间。眼下，我有一颗塞满被毒害希望的死亡岩石、一座低语着"超红线收成"的无名浮标，以及散落各处、被改动的报告，它们都指向同一名勘探员一直在把危险当作机会来卖。

#en: The Deepwater LT-7924 drifts cold and dark, but its hull still carries the habits of its last Trade Authority crew, etched into route logs and half-finished calculations. Whatever was first drawn here has already passed through too many hands and retellings, but the echoes of that origin still cling to this courier better than anywhere else. If any place remembers how a routine contract became a whispered legend about impossible jumps, it is this gutted shell between lanes. So far, the trail begins with a nameless rock and scattered rumors of lost freighters, all pointing toward one pilot who refuses to stay charted.
zh: 深水 LT-7924冰冷而黑暗地漂着，但它的船壳仍携着上一批贸易管理局船员的习惯，镌刻在航线日志与半途而废的计算里。最初在此绘出的东西，早已辗转太多双手、经过太多次重述，可那源头留下的回响，仍比任何地方都更紧地附着在这艘信使船上。若说哪处还记得一份例行合同如何变成关于不可能之跃迁的低语传说，那就是这道航线之间被掏空的船壳。目前为止，线索始于一块无名岩石与关于失踪货船的零散传闻，全都指向一名拒绝留在星图上的飞行员。

#en: The Trade Authority freighter hangs in orbit like a stalled heartbeat on the lane, and this is where the numbers were first bent to hide something no one wanted to name. Only inside this hull, buried between customs kiosks and neglected terminals, did a clerk dare squeeze truth into the margins, turning a routine cargo log into a map of missing metal and vanished workers. Whatever Rivet touched started passing through here before it disappeared into rumor. All we have so far are a burnt dataslate from some forgotten rock and dockside whispers that UC scrap, secret audits, and her name keep showing up in the same breath.
zh: 那艘贸易管理局货船悬在轨道上，像航道上一记停滞的心跳，而这里正是那些数字第一次被掰弯、用来藏起某件没人愿意点破之事的地方。只有在这具船壳之内、在海关亭与无人问津的终端之间，一名文书才敢把真相挤进页边空白，把一份例行的货运日志变成一张失踪金属与人间蒸发工人之图。凡是"铆钉"碰过的东西，都在化作传闻之前先经过这里。目前为止，我们只有一块来自某颗被遗忘岩石的烧焦数据板，以及码头边的低语：联殖废料、秘密审计和她的名字，总在同一个呼吸里一同出现。

#en: Out here, with the LX-2547 hanging dead against the stars, all the whispers say the numbers finally stopped adding up. A UC hull like this does not simply drift unless someone wants its records to go missing, and the way the bulkheads are scarred suggests more than a clean evacuation. Every rumor about rerouted derelicts, falsified manifests, and ships that were "too heavy to save" keeps circling back to this frame of steel and silence. People in backroom bars talk about a hidden cache found on a forgotten rock, a quiet contact on a border station, and now a warship log that shows the same hand trimming mass from the ledger.
zh: 在这里，LX-2547 死寂地悬在群星之前，所有的低语都说那些数字终于对不上了。像这样一艘联殖船体不会平白无故地漂着，除非有人想让它的记录消失；而那些舱壁上的伤痕说明，这远不是一次干净的撤离。关于被改道的弃船、被伪造的舱单，以及那些"重得救不回来"的船只的每一则传闻，都不断绕回这副钢铁与沉默的躯体。密室酒吧里的人谈论着一处在被遗忘岩石上发现的隐藏储藏点、一名边境站上的安静线人，以及如今一份军舰日志——它显示出同一只手正从账本上削去质量。

#en: New Atlantis dresses its math in glass and waterfalls, but the real gravity here sits in basement archives and forgotten backup nodes, where old traffic models are left to rot behind clearance walls. Buried in those systems is the first faint outline of a path that should not exist, a corridor sketched in corrections no one will admit to owning, each analyst and clerk swearing they only saw it after someone else had already run the numbers. So far all I have are a redacted hearing about a lost convoy, a pattern of near-misses in freighter logs, and a name that keeps surfacing in whispers when people think no one is recording.
zh: 新亚特兰蒂斯城给它的数学穿上玻璃与瀑布的外衣，但这里真正的引力藏在地下档案库与被遗忘的备份节点里，那些陈旧的交通模型被丢在保密墙后任其腐烂。埋在这些系统深处的，是一条本不该存在的路径最初那模糊的轮廓——一条由无人愿意承认自己所有物的修正所勾勒出的走廊；每个分析员和文书都发誓，自己只是在别人已经算过之后才看到它。眼下我只有一场关于一支失踪车队的涂黑听证会、货运日志里一连串惊险擦碰，以及一个每当人们以为无人记录时就会在低语中浮现的名字。

#en: Gagarin's freight corridors are where chance and routine pretend to be the same thing; cranes swing, manifests ping, and no one looks twice at another hauler sliding into dock. That is what makes this place useful to anyone trying to hide intent inside everyday traffic. If shipments keep vanishing off specific approaches, if escorts peel away on the same vector again and again, it will be charted here first, in grease-pencil notes and quietly edited schedules. So far it is a mislaid slate off the lanes, mismatched cargo tallies in these rusted bays, and a pattern of altered approaches that has stopped feeling like coincidence.
zh: 加加林星的货运走廊，是偶然与例行各自假装成对方的地方；吊臂摆动、舱单滴滴作响，没人会多看一眼又一艘滑进船坞的货船。正因如此，这地方对任何想把意图藏进日常交通的人来说都很好用。如果货物不断在特定进近航线上消失，如果护航船一次又一次在同一向量上脱离，那它一定会先在这里被记录下来——记在油性铅笔的便条和被悄悄修改的日程里。目前为止，只有一块落在航线外的数据板、这些锈迹斑斑的货舱里对不上的货物清单，以及一连串已经不再像巧合的进近改动。

#en: Neon hides things well: too much light, too much noise, and the right secret sinks like a stone in the glow. That is why this district matters. If someone with Luca's habits ever wanted to erase a trail, they would tuck it here, behind tasteful kiosks and corporate spin, beneath layers of mundane traffic logs and stale coffee cups. Yet rumors of bad vectors and near-misses keep circling back to the same elevators, the same side corridors where junior techs gossip on their breaks. So far the trail has run from a forgotten scrap picked up off-world to vague talk of doctored routes and a nameless hand quietly steering ships wrong.
zh: 霓虹城很擅长藏东西：光太多、噪声太多，而该藏的机密会像石头一样沉入那片辉光之中。这就是这个区份要紧的原因。若一个有着卢卡那种习性的人想要抹掉一条痕迹，他们会把它塞在这里——塞在雅致的售卖亭与公司的说辞背后，压在层层平凡的交通日志与放凉的咖啡杯之下。然而关于糟糕向量与惊险擦碰的传闻，总绕回同样的几部电梯、同样的几条侧廊，也就是年轻技工们在休息时闲聊八卦的地方。目前为止，这条线索从一块在太空捡来的被遗忘废料，延伸到关于被做手脚的航线，以及一只悄无声息把船引向错误的无名之手的含糊说辞。

#en: Out here in the dark, the orbiting wreck is more than drifting scrap; it is the one place his calculations cannot be rewritten by a boardroom or wiped from a settlement server.  \nTelemetry bleeds from the hull in thin, regular pulses, the kind an engineer leaves when he trusts machines more than people, and the ship pacing it like a wolf proves someone else has learned the value of his mistakes.  \nA misrouted courier, a forgotten maintenance bay, an unlogged ping from deep space, each small oversight left behind a trace; taken together, they drew the same crooked line, all pointing toward the man who sells the right to breathe.
zh: 在这片黑暗中，那具环绕轨道的残骸不只是漂着的废铁；它是他的计算唯一无法被董事会改写、也无法从某台定居点服务器上抹去的地方。  \n遥测数据以细而规律的脉冲从船壳渗漏而出，那是工程师在信任机器甚于信任人时留下的痕迹，而像狼一样尾随其后的那艘船证明，另有某人已经领会了他这些错误的价值。  \n一条被引错路的信使船、一座被遗忘的维修舱、一次来自深空的未记录讯号，每一处小小的疏忽都留下了一道痕迹；合在一起，它们画出了同一条歪斜的线，全都指向那个贩卖呼吸权的人。

#en: Old war concrete and dead antennas make this forgotten base the perfect place to hide a path through the gaps in official charts; no patrol bothers with relics nobody admits owning. The Scrapstar Haulers treat it as rumor made steel, each swearing someone else first mentioned the encoded routes stashed here. If those paths match his pattern of slipping between LIST scans and Argos lanes, they will narrow the hunt from open sky to a handful of dark corridors. So far, the trail runs from a nameless rock to malformed orbital readings and a hushed Trade Authority hull, all circling one surveyor who rewrites the frontier off the books.
zh: 旧日的战争混凝土与死掉的天线，让这座被遗忘的基地成为在官方星图缝隙里藏一条路径的绝佳地点；没有哪支巡逻队愿意为无人承认自己拥有的遗物费心。"废星运输队"把它当作化作钢铁的传闻，每人都发誓是别人先提起藏在这里的加密航线的。若那些路径符合他在独立盟扫描与阿戈斯航道之间溜来溜去的模式，就能把追猎从开阔天空收窄到几条黑暗走廊。目前为止，线索从一块无名岩石，延伸到畸形的轨道读数与一具沉默的贸易管理局船体，全都围绕着一个在账外改写边境的勘探员。

#en: Out here the ore platform spins alone, a forgotten dot on someone's balance sheet, but its automated systems are still dutifully parroting a course pattern that keeps showing up in barroom rumors and half-remembered sensor logs. Break that chain and whatever is listening on the far end will have to adjust, maybe even show a new hand. Some pilots swear they have seen the same freighter silhouette skimming these grids, others insist it is just a ghost in old UC nav code; no one agrees on the details, only that every story about strange wildlife, missing homesteads, and crooked telemetry seems to bend back toward this stretch of sky.
zh: 在这里，那座矿石平台孤零零地旋转，是某人资产负债表上一个被遗忘的小点，可它的自动化系统仍在尽职地重复着一种航向模式——它不断出现在酒吧传闻与记忆模糊的传感器日志里。打断那条链，远端正监听着的东西就不得不调整，甚至可能露出新的一只手。有些飞行员发誓见过同一个货船轮廓掠过这些网格，另一些人则坚称那只是旧联殖导航代码里的幽灵；没人对细节有一致说法，只知道每一则关于怪异野生生物、失踪定居点和歪斜遥测的故事，似乎都折回这片天空。

#en: This relay bunker is where signals came to be forgotten. UC built it to listen, then let it rot, leaving its racks humming on half power and its storage arrays quietly swallowing years of patrol data no one bothered to audit. Anything that passed through this grid lingered here long after it fell off official reports, including one set of atmospheric anomalies too precise to be weather and too shy to be logged as a routine flight. So far your trail is a scatter of corrupted buoy readings, a doctored cargo list in Neon, and a merchant captain's nervous story about a ship that crossed forbidden sky without ever showing on her scopes.
zh: 这座中继掩体，是信号被遗忘的地方。联殖建造它是为了监听，随后任其腐烂，让机架在半功率下嗡鸣，让存储阵列悄然吞下无人费心审计的多年巡逻数据。凡经过这片网格的东西，都会在从官方报告中消失很久之后仍在此徘徊，其中就包括一组大气异常——精确得不像天气，又腼腆得不会被登记为例行飞行。目前为止，你的线索是一堆损坏的浮标读数、霓虹城一份被做过手脚的货物清单，以及一名商船船长紧张兮兮的故事：一艘船穿越了禁飞天空，却从未出现在她的示波器上。

#en: Out here, the wind never quite settles and the dust never falls in the same pattern twice, yet every local navigator swears their ships drift the same few degrees off course whenever they cross this valley. Whatever was planted beneath these half collapsed antennas is tugging at flight computers more persistently than any storm, bending routes just enough that freighters and survey crews start telling the same bad luck story in different bars. Somewhere along the way the original account frayed into rumor and blame, leaving only a dead hauler's slate and a nameless pathfinder whispered about whenever a convoy vanishes between systems.
zh: 在这里，风从未真正停歇，尘土也从不以同样的图案落两次，可每一位当地领航员都发誓，每当他们的船穿过这道山谷，航向就会偏出同样的几度。埋在这些半塌天线底下的东西，比任何风暴都更执拗地拉扯着飞行计算机，把航线掰弯到刚好让货船与勘探队开始在不同的酒吧里讲述同一个倒霉故事。一路走来，最初的叙述磨散成了传闻与责怪，只留下一块死掉的货船数据板，以及每当有车队在星系间消失时就会被低声议论的无名引路人。

#en: The old science wing still hums with dormant diagnostics, its walls lined with dead displays that once modeled safe lanes through the dark. This is where someone with Vector's training would test new corrections in peace, burying them inside harmless research datasets until smugglers, corporates, and UC auditors all started repeating the same half-remembered story about a draft that could bend a jump like a rumor bends the truth. To make sense of it you follow the trail: the anonymous dataslate in the dust, the altered beacon in high orbit, the nervous talk in Gagarin's bars about ships turning aside just before everything went wrong.
zh: 那栋旧科学翼楼仍在发出休眠诊断的嗡鸣，墙上排着一列死掉的显示屏——它们曾为穿越黑暗绘出安全航道。正是在这里，一个受过"向量"那种训练的人能安静地测试新修正，把它们埋进无害的研究数据集里，直到走私者、公司人和联殖审计员都开始重复同一个记忆模糊的故事：一份草稿能像传闻扭曲真相那样掰弯一次跃迁。要理清它，你就得循着线索走：尘土里那块匿名数据板、高轨道上被改动的信标，以及加加林星酒吧里关于船只在一切出错前恰好转开的紧张交谈。
